The man was trying to escape someone who was holding him against his will. As part of the plan, he willingly hid inside the coffin of someone who had agreed to open it and free him after the funeral. The coffin was buried with him inside. When he struck a match, he recognized the deceased as the person he was counting on to rescue him—and realized they had unexpectedly died, so they would not come. Trapped in the buried coffin with a life-threatening environmental hazard and no timely rescue, he died. The match revealed that his escape plan had failed; the deceased’s presence did not itself physically cause his death.
